newsitem.title: USA: Viosca Knoll sets natgas gathering contracts.
newsitem.headline: Viosca Knoll sets natgas gathering contracts.

text.p: Viosca Knoll Gathering Co on Tuesday said it entered arrangements to provide natural gas gathering services for Snyder Oil Corp in Main Pass Block 261 and for Texaco Inc and Marathon Oil Co in Viosca Knoll Block 786.
The company also said it planned to add facilities to accommodate incremental capacity requirements from the Gulf of Mexico areas off eastern Louisiana.
The company said it intended to construct a 25-mile-long, 20-inch-wide pipeline and related facilities from Main Pass Block 261 to Viosca Knoll Block 817.
The construction is expected to be completed during the third quarter of this year, it said.

Recent throughput on the Viosca Knoll Gathering System has exceeded 400 million cubic feet per day, the company said, adding it expects substantial production increases in the Main Pass, Viosca Knoll and Mississippi Canyon areas from existing dedicated developments and from new drilling activity around the system.

As a result, the company expects to make interconnections with new pipelines recently announced by Williams Cos Inc's Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Co and Destin Pipeline Co LLC, which is owned by Sonat Inc's, Shell Oil Co and Amoco Corp.
Such interconnections, together with the new facilities, will make the Viosca Knoll system capable of delivering more than one billion cubic feet per day to multiple interstate markets.
Viosca Knoll Gathering is a joint venture of Leviathan Gas Pipeline Partners LP and El Paso Energy Corp. DeepTech International Inc owns an effective 23.2 percent of Leviathan.
